variants.name: pi-report
variants.description: Write the status report to the PI (the boss) in plain Traditional Chinese - problem, cause, recommended fix, what professional sources were consulted. Use whenever a work session, batch, audit or investigation has to be reported to the PI.

variants.name: pi-report-weak
variants.description: Same job as pi-report (PI status report in plain Traditional Chinese), with extra guidance for a weaker model. Use only when a Sonnet- or Haiku-class model is explicitly wanted; otherwise use pi-report.
